Part-Time Worker.name: Part-Time Worker
Part-Time Worker.description:
☕ You worked convenience store nights and café weekends.

💴 You have earned your own money all through high school.
🧾 You know how to serve customers and how a small business runs.

📈 Grants: Hospitality +5, Business +5
Part-Time Worker.traitNarrativeEffects: The character worked part-time jobs through high school: registers, stock, difficult customers and shift schedules. They are practical about money, polite under pressure and know how small businesses run.
